verdict.rationale: The SDK ships in TypeScript with typed option objects (`Options` / `ClaudeAgentOptions`) and typed message classes such as `AssistantMessage`, which gives some static typing. Structured outputs validate agent results against a defined schema and re-prompt on mismatch. However, that validation happens at runtime, not at build time, and nothing documents strict type-checking that lets an agent catch its own mistakes before running. Missing for 10: documented strict static typing or type-checking guarantees, build-time schema validation of tool definitions and inputs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
